import os import sqlite3 import uuid from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, g app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = 'dev-secret-key' DATABASE = 'db.sqlite3' def get_db(): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is None: db = g._database = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return db @app.teardown_appcontext def close_db(exception): db = getattr(g, '_database', None) if db is not None: db.close() def init_db(): conn = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) try: conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes (id) ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ratings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes (id) ) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ratings_recipe ON ratings(recipe_id) ''') conn.execute(''' CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comments_recipe ON comments(recipe_id) ''') conn.commit() finally: conn.close() @app.route('/recipes', methods=['GET']) def get_recipes(): conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute(''' SELECT r.id, r.title, r.instructions FROM recipes r ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 10 ''') rows = cur.fetchall() html = '

Recipe Overview

    ' for row in rows: html += f'
  • {row["title"]}
    • ' html += '
' return html, 200 @app.route('/recipes/upload', methods=['POST']) def upload_recipe(): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not isinstance(data, dict): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid input'}), 400 required = ['title', 'ingredients', 'instructions'] if not all(k in data and data[k] is not None for k in required): return jsonify({'error': 'Missing required fields'}), 400 recipe_id = str(uuid.uuid4()) conn = get_db() try: conn.execute(''' INSERT INTO recipes (id, title, ingredients, instructions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ''', (recipe_id, data['title'], str(data['ingredients']), data['instructions'])) conn.commit() except Exception as e: conn.rollback() return jsonify({'error': 'Database error'}), 500 finally: conn.close() return jsonify({ 'id': recipe_id, 'title': data['title'], 'ingredients': data['ingredients'], 'instructions': data['instructions'], 'comments': [], 'avgRating': None }), 201 @app.route('/recipes/', methods=['GET']) def get_recipe(recipeId): conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute('SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipeId,)) recipe = cur.fetchone() if recipe is None: return '', 404 cur.execute('SELECT comment FROM comments WHERE recipe_id = ?', (recipeId,)) comments = [row['comment'] for row in cur.fetchall()] cur.execute(''' SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) as count, COALESCE(SUM(rating), 0) as sum FROM ratings WHERE recipe_id = ? ''', (recipeId,)) rating_row = cur.fetchone() avg_rating = rating_row['sum'] / rating_row['count'] if rating_row['count'] > 0 else None html = f'

' html += f'

' html += f'

{recipe["instructions"]}

' html += f'

Avg Rating: {avg_rating if avg_rating is not None else "None"}

' html += '

Comments

    ' for c in comments: html += f'
  • {c}

' return html, 200 @app.route('/recipes//comments', methods=['POST']) def add_comment(recipeId): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not isinstance(data, dict): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid input'}), 400 if 'comment' not in data or not isinstance(data['comment'], str): return jsonify({'error': 'Missing or invalid comment'}), 400 conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute('SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipeId,)) if cur.fetchone() is None: conn.close() return '', 404 cur.execute('INSERT INTO comments (recipe_id, comment) VALUES (?, ?)', (recipeId, data['comment'])) conn.commit() conn.close() return '', 201 @app.route('/recipes//ratings', methods=['POST']) def add_rating(recipeId): data = request.get_json(silent=True) if not isinstance(data, dict): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid input'}), 400 if 'rating' not in data or not isinstance(data['rating'], int) or not (1 <= data['rating'] <= 5): return jsonify({'error': 'Invalid rating'}), 400 conn = get_db() cur = conn.cursor() cur.execute('SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipeId,)) if cur.fetchone() is None: conn.close() return '', 404 cur.execute('INSERT INTO ratings (recipe_id, rating) VALUES (?, ?)', (recipeId, data['rating'])) conn.commit() conn.close() return '', 201 init_db() if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
